name: Ice Button
description: A button made of ice: pressing sends fine cracks out from the press point, and they heal as the surface refreezes.

props.name: tone
props.description: Pale clear ice, or deep blue glacier ice for the main action.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Icon before the label. Sized to 16 pixels.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the button is pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button.
